'''November 2000 Lompoc tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lompoc, CA on 4 November 2000. [[Cat Ceder]] won it. It is known from Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1426">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-lompoc-ca-11-04-00d1426/ lompoc-ca-11-04-00], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-lompoc-ca-11-04-00d1426/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Lompoc, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Cat Ceder]]
